content: Django 6.0 official editing docs describe DeletionMixin.delete as fetching/deleting the object and redirecting; auth docs distinguish inactive authentication from authorization, and AllowAllUsersModelBackend permits inactive sessions. Current-source replay on Django 4.2.30/6.0.9 reproduced DELETE bypass and inactive Guardian list disclosure. https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/6.0/ref/class-based-views/mixins-editing/ https://docs.djangoproject.com/en/6.0/topics/auth/customizing/
